data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 advances a causal-modular invariance argument, explicitly asserting the recurrence is 'invariant modulo 3', and draws catastrophic conclusions from this alleged invariant: it asserts the sequence collapses to only two faces out of six, with the transfer claim that only faces {1,4} ever appear. A direct counterexample to this invariant exists: 1103515245 ≡ 1 (mod 3) and 12345 ≡ 0 (mod 3). Under these constants, X_{n+1} ≡ 1·X_n + 0 (mod 3), which has a period-3 cycle (1→1→1...), not a collapse to a single residue class modulo 3. The catastrophic invariant and the conclusion that only two faces ever appear are not supported by the actual modular arithmetic.
